title: The Strongest Princess Demon Lord Was Banished From Another World for Being Too Cute, and Became the Main Heroine of a School Rom-Com ~She’s Utterly Stone Cold, but Actually a Pure-Hearted Maiden Who’s Crazy About Me~
description:
With the start of high school just around the corner, Shinonome Souma was looking forward to enjoying the indoor high school life of his dreams, spending his days immersed in games and anime.

But then, Valkyanna, a ridiculously cute Demon Queen from another world who was simultaneously “self-assured,” “innocent and carefree,” and the “strongest being in another world,” suddenly appeared in his life and is hopelessly, desperately in love with Souma!! With the arrival of this bold and fearless Princess Demon Lord, Souma's high school life will be full of unpredictable surprises!! And what about the feelings Valkyanna is hiding deep in her heart?

A manga adaptation of the fantasy rom-com winner of the original story contest from Hobby Japan's "Novel Up+" and YanMaga Web!!
author: Mainu
